title: Writing Task 1 - Process Diagram: Manufacturing
description: IELTS Writing Task 1: Describe a process diagram showing how glass bottles are manufactured and recycled.

stimuli.title: Task 1: Glass Bottle Manufacturing and Recycling Process
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The diagram below shows the process of manufacturing glass bottles and how they are recycled after use.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Process stages — Manufacturing: Raw materials (sand, soda ash, limestone) → Mixing → Furnace (1500°C melting) → Moulding → Cooling → Quality check → Distribution. Recycling: Collection → Sorting by colour → Crushing into cullet → Returned to furnace → Remoulding.

questionGroups.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

questions.content: Describe the process diagram showing glass bottle manufacturing and recycling.

keyFeatures: The manufacturing process begins with three raw materials being combined before melting
The furnace stage at 1500 degrees Celsius is the most energy-intensive step
Recycling re-enters the cycle at the furnace stage, bypassing raw material extraction
The recycling loop is shorter with only five stages compared to seven in manufacturing
